defective_pattern: Bypassing python-docx p.alignment and appending <w:jc> to <w:pPr> manually.
why_defective: Causes ECMA-376 schema validation failures in Word; <w:jc> is placed after <w:rPr>, causing Word on Windows to ignore the alignment and default to Left.
observed_symptoms: Text in Microsoft Word is visually Left-aligned despite RTL BiDi being active
Word ribbon highlights Align Left instead of Right or Justify
corrective_remedy: Set p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.RIGHT/CENTER/JUSTIFY and p.paragraph_format.bidi = True.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: grep for 'set_element(pPr, 'w:jc'' in docx generation scripts
